approval_context.record_state_at_analysis_time: project records still contained awaiting_human_review and require main-agent reconciliation

feasibility.summary: A valid reviewable layered source can be produced deterministically with path masks, preserved source pixels, fixed clone and vector restoration, and reassembly QA. Automatic colour segmentation alone cannot produce a valid source because touching components share deep-plum, peach, cream and coral colours.
feasibility.required_architecture_change: Keep body paint, shading, outer ink and vintage texture as one locked clean body plate. Do not independently animate colour-region sublayers.
not_permitted: relocating or retyping the Evolved shoe artwork
automatic colour-key separation as the final mask source

reassembly_acceptance.visible_pixel_rule: Every source-visible pixel outside explicitly documented restoration-only masks must reproduce the approved candidate RGBA values exactly.
reassembly_acceptance.alpha_rule: No new alpha fringe, matte line or clipped antialiasing at 100, 200 and 400 percent inspection.
reassembly_acceptance.difference_test: Flatten the layered source at neutral and compare with the approved candidate. Any non-zero visible difference outside approved seam masks fails.
articulation_test: Move each arm 20 degrees away from body and inspect restored side contour and root overlap.
Bend each arm 20 degrees at tube-bend pivot and inspect for double outlines or gaps.
Move each leg 12 degrees and inspect shorts overlap and hidden leg roots.
Bend each leg 15 degrees and inspect tube continuity without anatomical knee shaping.
Rotate each leaf 8 degrees and stem 4 degrees and inspect restored cleft.
Move each pupil to four safe extremes and inspect the completed eye-white plate.
Confirm anatomical left remains viewer-right at neutral and the right shoe remains blank.

visual_risks: The approved anatomical-left FRD001 shoe is cleaner and more side-readable than the reconstructed blank shoe; separation must not increase this mismatch.
The left and right neutral gloves are newly reconstructed, asymmetrical and pose-specific. Automatic contour smoothing would alter their approved silhouettes.
The arm and leg tubes have no visible joint seams. Creating upper and lower layers requires concealed overlap capsules and a new layered-source review.
The body top, side contours and face field contain hidden pixels that do not exist in the flattened source. Their deterministic restoration is new artwork and must be reviewed.
The face uses shared black regions for pupils, lashes and outlines. Colour thresholding will merge unrelated parts.
Cream appears in eyes, gloves, laces, soles, highlights and the shoe word. Colour thresholding will cross-contaminate layers.
The candidate and layer sources have no embedded sRGB or ICC profile. The layered source and exports must be explicitly tagged sRGB.
Existing project and layer-map records still described the visual gate as awaiting review at analysis time and require main-agent status reconciliation.
